ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Imagine that sunlight was removed from the diagram below. What would happen immediately to the phytoplankton population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the figure is “FERTILIZATION AND FOOD CHAIN”; there is the sun above, with “SUNLIGHT” labeled beside it, and an arrow points from the direction of the sun into the water; “PHYTOPLANKTON” is labeled in the water, and it is shown as being near the bottom of the food chain. Reasoning: The question asks what would immediately happen to the phytoplankton population if sunlight were removed. Phytoplankton rely on sunlight to carry out photosynthesis to make nutrients and grow; without sunlight, their survival and reproduction would be affected. Therefore the number of phytoplankton would decrease.
